senses.gloss:
mn. (-स्नुः-स्नु)
Table land, the level summit or edge of a mountain.
E.
ष्णु to trickle, (the water or snow from it,) डु aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Flowing, dropping, oozing, trickling, distilled.
E.
ष्णु to ooze, aff. क्त.

f. (-षा)
1 A daughter-in-law.
2 The milk-hedge plant.
E.
ष्णु to distil, Uṇādi aff. स.

f. (-स्नुक्)
The milk-hedge plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum, &c.)
E.
ष्णुह to vomit, (its milk being used as an emetic,) aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added, स्नुहा.

f. (-हिः-ही)
A plant, (Euphorbia antiquorum.)
E.
ष्णुह to vomit, (see the last,) कि aff., and ङीष् optionally added.
